title: See who is in a WhatsApp group, and filter to groups only
text: Open a group in the WhatsApp tab and press Members to see everyone in it: name, phone number and an Admin tag. If a number belongs to a client or lead in the CRM, their CRM name shows too. A new Groups button next to All / Unread / Read shows only the group chats.
points: CRM name when the number is known
stepsTitle: Seeing who is in a group

steps.name: Open a group chat
steps.detail: It has the green Group label.

steps.name: Press Members
steps.detail: A window lists everyone in the group.

steps.name: Press Groups above the list
steps.detail: Only group chats stay in the list.
